title: Permissions
description: Control who can use each bot command, per module. Override by role, user, Discord permission or channel. {admin} always passes. {blocked} beats {allowed}. No override = the command's default permission.
overrideCount: {count, plural, one {# override configured.} other {# overrides configured.}}
